objective: Make L17-L19 evolution events durable and auditable by appending them to the PAEOS ledger. Context: the ledger (.paeos_state/ledger.db) contains ONLY goal (125) and seal (25) rows — zero RETROSPECT / EVOLVE / MEMORY_UPDATE / IMPROVE_RUNTIME events have ever been recorded, so the EvolutionLayer (runtime/evolution.py, invoked from ops/autonomous_run.py:103) has run without leaving any auditable trace, and institutional learning cannot be verified (hallucination notebook Entries 141-142; backlog/research/PAEOS_DURABLE_MEMORY_RB_v0.1.md). Deliverables: (1) extend EvolutionLayer to accept an optional ledger (kernel.ledger.Ledger) and clock callable; after each stage it must append an Event with kind EVOLUTION_EVENT and payload {layer: RETROSPECT|EVOLVE|MEMORY_UPDATE|IMPROVE_RUNTIME, run_id, goal_id, status, summary}; events must be appended via the kernel's ledger append API only — never raw SQL; (2) wire it in ops/autonomous_run.py so the constructed EvolutionLayer receives the same Ledger instance the SoftLoop uses; (3) tests in tests/runtime/test_evolution_ledger.py proving: a completed run appends the four evolution events in order, a failed run appends at minimum the RETROSPECT event with the failure status, and the ledger chain still verifies (verify_chain) after the appends.
accept: runtime/evolution.py EvolutionLayer appends EVOLUTION_EVENT rows via the kernel ledger API for each L17-L19 stage
ops/autonomous_run.py passes the shared Ledger into EvolutionLayer
tests/runtime/test_evolution_ledger.py proves ordered appends, failure-path appends, and chain verification stays green
goal_signature: runtime/evolution ledger durability L17 L18 L19 evolution events auditability
